title: First-time setup
intro: Welcome to BiblioViva. In a few steps the library is ready: language, colours, school, codes and staff passwords.

language.title: Which language should BiblioViva speak?
language.hint: One language per installation: it applies to all staff and can be changed from Administration → Configuration → Appearance and language.

pack.title: Need another language?
pack.hint: The other languages published with this version of BiblioViva are downloaded from GitHub, or their zip is uploaded. Once installed, the setup goes on in that language and BiblioViva uses it for everyone.

restore.title: Already have a BiblioViva backup?
restore.hint: To move BiblioViva to another computer, or to start again after a failure, there are no questions to answer: an archive made with “Export everything” is enough.

theme.title: Choose the colours
theme.hint: Fifteen colour sets: they change colours only, never the shape. All light and readable in black and white too.

library.title: The library
library.name: Library name
library.schoolTypeHint: The years and the classes as the school uses them. They can be changed later in Administration → Configuration → School and Administration → Configuration → Classes.
library.photosHint: Photos of students and teachers, taken or uploaded, and printed on the cards. Off: no photo anywhere and cards without a photo.
library.coversHint: Covers looked up online, photographed or uploaded, and shown in the catalogue. Off: no cover.

school.title: The school
school.hint: The type of school proposes the years, the classes and the reading levels. The classes are made right away; with the demo data they fill up with made-up students.

names.perLevel: {{stage}}: names of the classes, one per year
names.mixed: {{stage}}: names of the sections, each with every year

school.namesHint: Separated by commas; A-D stands for A, B, C, D. Empty: no classes.
school.namesInvalid: Invalid names: type them separated by commas (40 at most).
school.teacherGroupHint: Every teacher joins this group; more groups can be added later.
school.schoolYearStartHint: Month and day as MM-DD (for example 09-01).
school.schoolYearStartInvalid: Write the month and the day as MM-DD.
school.readingLevelsHint: Years, classes and reading levels can be changed later in Administration.

codes.title: The codes
codes.hint: The barcode format of new copies and the one of new cards, each chosen on its own. The two shapes can never be confused: whoever reads a code knows at once whether it is a book or a card.

itemFormats.classic: Year and number, check at the end
itemFormats.prefix: With the letter L in front

cardFormats.prefix: With the letter T in front

codes.layoutHint: The keyboard language of the computer the barcode scanners are plugged into: it repairs swapped characters. If yours is not listed, choose the closest one: it can be changed later in Configuration → Barcodes.
codes.verdict: Copies and cards can never be confused.
codes.refused: With this choice copies and cards could be confused: pick another format.
codes.later: Formats, codes of older systems and numbering can be changed later in Configuration → Barcodes.

passwords.title: Staff passwords
passwords.hint: Five shared accounts, one per role. The proposed passwords are random and can be replaced. Note them down on the final step: they are shown only once. Personal accounts, one per person with their role, are added later in Administration → Staff accounts.
passwords.demo: With the demo data every account uses the same easy password: “{{password}}”. Before using BiblioViva for real, change them in Administration → Staff accounts.

demo.title: Sample data
demo.hint: Made-up students, books and loans to try the application. They are removed with one click from Administration when the real data comes in.
demo.hasData: The database already contains data: sample data will not be loaded.

summary.title: Summary
summary.hint: Check and confirm. The passwords appear only on this page: copy them before moving on.
summary.later: Later on, passwords are changed in Administration → Staff accounts.

done.title: Setup completed
done.hint: Keep these passwords somewhere safe: they will not be shown again.
done.demoLoaded: Sample data loaded: {{patrons}} {{patrons:plural; one:patron; other:patrons;}}, {{biblios}} {{biblios:plural; one:title; other:titles;}}, {{items}} {{items:plural; one:copy; other:copies;}}, {{loans}} {{loans:plural; one:loan; other:loans;}}.

restore.title: Restore from a backup
restore.hint: Choose the archive made with “Export everything” (Administration → Backup). Maximum size: {{maxMb}} MB. The archive is checked before anything is restored.
restore.from: Archive of the library “{{library}}”, made on {{date}}, version {{version}}.
restore.accounts: Accounts that will be able to log in: {{accounts}}. The passwords are those of the archive.
restore.warning: The restore brings settings, data and pictures back as they were in the archive, all at once. Afterwards the setup wizard is no longer needed.

done.title: Restore completed
done.hint: The library is as it was in the archive. To log in, use one of these accounts with the password it had in the archive:

errors.too_large: The archive is too large (maximum {{maxMb}} MB).
errors.not_zip: The file is not a valid ZIP archive.
errors.not_archive: The file is not a BiblioViva archive: choose an archive made with “Export everything”.
errors.too_many_files: The archive contains too many files.
errors.unsafe_path: The archive contains a path that is not allowed: {{name}}
errors.link: The archive contains a link, which is not allowed: {{name}}
errors.unknown_file: The archive contains a file that is not part of BiblioViva: {{name}}
errors.not_setup: The setup wizard has already been completed: restoring is done from Administration → Backup.
errors.newer_version: The archive was made by a newer version of BiblioViva ({{name}}): install that version first.
errors.missing_parts: The archive is incomplete: {{name}} are missing. Choose an archive made with “Export everything”.
errors.unfinished_setup: The archive comes from an installation where the setup wizard had not been completed.
errors.not_ready: The archive has problems and cannot be restored: {{name}}
errors.gone: The checked archive is gone: choose it again.
